title: Reference document for authorised use: eligible goods and authorised uses
text: This document lists the uses to which goods declared to an Authorised Use Procedure can be subject to. It will be introduced by reference in a Statutory Instrument ( SI ) to follow, and a link to that SI will be added to this page when the SI has been published.
changeNote: Authorised Use: Eligible Goods and Authorised Uses, version 2.27, dated 27 October 2026 (entry into force 26 November 2026) added.
